checked.description: The areas and scenarios that were looked at, whether or not they yielded a finding. An empty findings list means nothing without this.

checked_against.description: Whether the claim was looked up in the tree (and, where it matters, the touched paths' history) or rests on the diff alone. The review step treats the two differently.

evidence.description: What in the tree, the diff or the touched paths' history bears the claim out — a file and line, a commit, a command and its output. A finding without one is a hypothesis, and a hypothesis is not reported as a finding.
